title: pilosella prussica subsp. elatior
intro: Pilosella prussica subsp. elatior, commonly known as False Oxeye Daisy, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family, native to Eastern Europe. The health benefits of Pilosella prussica subsp. elatior include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce fluid retention, and its potential to inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella prussica subsp. elatior include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
